From: Erin Carroll <erin.carroll@medsprint.com>

Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Need short runway while PO routes

Hi Mina,

Quick note from procurement — our PO for Redwood (PO #MS-2219) is currently routing through three approval gates and finance flagged a vendor review which pushed the ETA out to next week. We were hoping to avoid losing the work we’ve done in the sandbox: our eng team has an integration demo scheduled for 11/15 and the test harness relies on the sandbox environment you provisioned.

Can Redwood provide a short runway (sandbox/top-up credits) to keep the evaluation environment active while the PO clears? We expect final signature by 11/14 but the routing is out of our control. Attached is the current PO draft for reference.

We’re flexible on the exact form — tokens, a short environment extension, or a temporary seat — whatever is easiest operationally. Please let me know if you need confirmation from our procurement contact (cc’d: devops@medsprint.com).

Appreciate any help — this demo is material for our internal approval to move to a dedicated instance later this quarter.

Thanks,
Erin Carroll
Sr. Product Ops — MedSprint

Hi Erin —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the draft PO. Totally understand the situation; we’ve seen routing stalls like this before. I can temporarily keep your sandbox active. Before I do, couple quick asks so I can route the internal approval: 

- Confirm expected final signature date (you mentioned 11/14 — does procurement have a firm ETA?).
- Confirm whether you want token credits applied to your existing sandbox or a short-term seat provisioning.
- If you have an internal purchase tracker number, please include it so our finance team can tie the temporary credit to the PO.

I’m looping in Ben (CS) to provision and Soojin (RevOps) to sign off on the short-term credit against our pilot program. Tentatively I can authorize a 7-day sandbox keepalive, but final activation depends on RevOps approval.

Ben/Soojin — can you confirm whether we can do a 7-day environment extension for MedSprint under deal RDW-4721? If 7 days is too aggressive, we can start with 5 and extend if PO continues to stall.

Thanks — I’ll hold here until I hear back and will follow up once we have the internal greenlight.

Best,
